title: Celebrating America's 250th: How UI papermakers helped preserve founding documents

title: Why 'The Odyssey' still matters, 3,000 years later
summary_en: Celsiana Warwick, assistant professor in the University of Iowa Department of Classics, explains why the ancient poem "The Odyssey" still feels strikingly modern — and what students and readers can learn from it today. Her forthcoming book, Gendered Voices in the Iliad, will be published by Oxford University Press in August.
